description: This file defines a Java interface 'TextProvider' that provides methods for setting and getting display text, serving as an abstraction for the display component of a Calculator application.

classes.name: TextProvider
classes.description: An interface that abstracts the display functionality for a Calculator, allowing setting and retrieving display text.

methods.name: setDisplayText
methods.description: Sets the text to be displayed on the Calculator's display.

methods.name: getDisplayText
methods.description: Retrieves the current text displayed on the Calculator.
